verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor with a local inference software stack. It has no hosted storage service with selectable regions, so choosing a data-residency region is a category error for this product type. The GAIA docs say local inference keeps data on-device, but that is a different privacy property, not a region-selection capability, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
